title: Ready
behavior: Normal explicit Open. No SMS history, Sender-presence claim or code list.

title: Not Ready / first setup
behavior: Explicit first launch opens pairing first; this main state is inspectable afterward.

properties.reason: Pair a phone to start receiving messages.

title: Not Ready / no paired phones
behavior: If R remains valid, Pair a phone uses ordinary add-Sender, not a new Receiver.

properties.reason: No paired phones. Add a phone to this receiver.

title: Not Ready / reconnecting
behavior: Automatic backoff continues; no repeated error popup or extra top-level state.

title: Not Ready / network unavailable
behavior: Wait for network improvement and normal backoff. Do not offer insecure TLS.

properties.reason: The service cannot be reached. Retrying automatically.

title: Not Ready / another connection
behavior: No takeover/reset button. Follow the same approved automatic backoff.

properties.reason: Another connection is active. Retrying automatically.

title: Local receiver data unavailable
behavior: Stop reconnecting. Only an explicit New registration begins the replacement flow.

properties.reason: Local receiver data cannot be opened.
properties.notice: Register as a new receiver. Remove the old pairing on every Android phone.

title: One phone needs attention
behavior: Known Windows-local key failure only; other Pairings and R keep working.

properties.notice: One phone needs to be paired again. Other phones keep working.

title: Receiver removed
behavior: Authoritative revocation: identity/keys/pending work/SMS/OTP cleared; settings kept.

properties.reason: This receiver was removed from the account.
properties.notice: To use this computer again, explicitly register a new receiver.

title: Ordinary protocol error
behavior: User-visible ordinary error. No forced-update or special retry policy.

properties.reason: The connection could not be understood. Retrying automatically.
properties.notice: The previous connection used an unsupported message format.

title: One message could not be read
behavior: No invalid SMS popup, no inferred key loss, no secret error details; continue later messages.

properties.notice: One message could not be read. Earlier valid codes are unaffected.

title: Tray integration unavailable
behavior: Only visible after explicit Open; startup never opens a window to report it.

properties.notice: The tray icon is unavailable. Reopen Pin Glide from the Start menu.

title: Preparing a QR
behavior: No QR before session/handshake material exists.

title: Waiting / live QR
behavior: QR lives five minutes. Closing the UI does not cancel. No auto-rotation.

title: Phone authorized
behavior: Only authoritative session/relay state can advance this; a scan alone is not observable.

title: Local key confirmation
behavior: Human progress text; do not expose challenges or declare Ready early.

title: Protected local write
behavior: A protected write failure is not a completed pairing.

title: Waiting for completion
behavior: Do not guess the other side's confirmation or show fabricated percentage.

title: Credential ready
behavior: Internal credential_ready; still Not Ready for a new Receiver.

title: Registration result uncertain
behavior: Same persisted operation; never attach unrestricted redemption retries to the UI.

properties.notice: Keep this operation open. Closing the window does not interrupt it.

title: Credential issued / first connection
behavior: R has been stored; first delivery upgrade has not completed. Do not claim Ready.

title: New receiver Ready
behavior: Only after the first successful delivery connection. Hidden completion stays quiet.

properties.heading: Ready
properties.detail: Your phone is paired with this computer.

title: Additional phone paired
behavior: No R redemption. Preserve the existing delivery connection and all other Pairings.

properties.heading: Phone paired
properties.detail: The new phone is now paired with this receiver.
properties.completion-detail: The existing receiver connection is unchanged.

title: QR expired
behavior: Stale QR is no longer shown. Refresh explicitly creates new session/material.

title: Could not create session
behavior: Try again creates a session; there is no broken QR or false success.

properties.progress: Could not prepare a pairing code.
properties.notice: The service could not be reached.

title: Pairing channel interrupted
behavior: Preserve the live session; reconcile or wait for its real terminal state.

title: Secure confirmation failed
behavior: Never Ready. Fresh pairing is offered only after safe terminal cleanup.

properties.progress: Secure pairing could not be confirmed.
properties.notice: Existing paired phones and their keys are unchanged.

title: Could not save secure data
behavior: No false completion. Preserve existing data and route through safe operation recovery.

properties.progress: Could not save secure pairing data.
properties.notice: Check local storage access. Existing phones are unchanged.

title: Session canceled / superseded
behavior: Closing a window did not cause this. Expected following Close 1008 keeps this outcome.

properties.progress: This pairing code is no longer active.
properties.notice: The session ended. Start a fresh pairing when ready.

title: Authoritative authorization error
behavior: Only show a reason Windows actually receives. Otherwise Android owns the rejection UI.

properties.progress: The phone could not join this receiver.
properties.notice: Check the pairing message shown in the Android app.

title: Confirm a new Receiver
behavior: Only explicit New registration opens this. Cancel does nothing; failure preserves old local data.

title: Default settings
behavior: Startup ON, shortcut Unassigned, 30 seconds. No theme, cache-expiry or history controls.

title: Capture shortcut
behavior: Escape cancels. Enter applies a complete supported chord; the old shortcut remains registered.

title: Incomplete shortcut
behavior: Field error. Keep old valid configuration/registration.

properties.shortcut-error: Choose a complete supported key combination.

title: Shortcut already in use
behavior: Registration failed; the previous working shortcut remains intact.

properties.shortcut-error: This shortcut is already in use. The previous shortcut is unchanged.

title: Shortcut registration/clear failed
behavior: Show actual OS state; do not claim Unassigned after a failed unregister.

properties.shortcut-error: Could not change the shortcut. The previous setting remains active.

title: Shortcut cleared
behavior: Unassigned, no success toast; reception and popup copying unaffected.

title: Startup registration failed
behavior: Actual OFF state is shown. Reception still works. Automatic startup never opens this page.

properties.notice: Could not enable launch at login. Try the checkbox again.

title: Invalid popup duration
behavior: Last saved value remains. Exact supported input bounds are not yet decided.

properties.duration-error: Enter a positive whole number of seconds.

title: Settings write failed
behavior: Keep last saved config and actual OS integration state; no false success.

properties.notice: Could not save the change. The last saved settings remain in use.

title: SMS with an OTP
behavior: Full unchanged fixed test SMS; Copy uses this popup's exact OTP.

title: SMS without an OTP
behavior: Full SMS. Copy action hidden as a proposal; previous latest OTP is not cleared.

properties.sms:
[Pin Glide] Your parcel is ready at the front desk.
Please collect it before 20:00.

title: Long original SMS
behavior: Fixed window; wrapped, scrollable body. Copy/Close remain reachable.

properties.sms:
[Pin Glide] Verification code: 482913.

Original message paragraph 1. Keep this text exactly as received; do not shorten or rewrite it.

Original message paragraph 2. Keep this text exactly as received; do not shorten or rewrite it.

Original message paragraph 3. Keep this text exactly as received; do not shorten or rewrite it.

Original message paragraph 4. Keep this text exactly as received; do not shorten or rewrite it.

Original message paragraph 5. Keep this text exactly as received; do not shorten or rewrite it.

Original message paragraph 6. Keep this text exactly as received; do not shorten or rewrite it.

Original message paragraph 7. Keep this text exactly as received; do not shorten or rewrite it.

Original message paragraph 8. Keep this text exactly as received; do not shorten or rewrite it.

title: Non-numeric / long OTP
behavior: Code area scrolls horizontally; never normalize or trim the original copy value.

title: Popup clipboard failure
behavior: Keep popup/code/body for retry. No success UI.

title: Shortcut / no code
behavior: Brief non-activating feedback. Clipboard unchanged. No main-window activation.

title: Latest-code clipboard failure
behavior: Retain cache. Retry by invoking latest-code copy again; coalesce repeated feedback.

properties.heading: Could not copy
properties.detail: The clipboard could not be updated. Your code is still in memory. Try the shortcut again.

title: Ready / latest code available
behavior: OS-native context menu in production; this image shows content only, not an actual Win32 capture.

title: No cached OTP
behavior: Copy latest code is disabled. It never writes an empty string.

title: First-use unpaired
behavior: Tray only on automatic launch; explicit Pair a phone opens first pairing.

title: Revoked / registration required
behavior: Pair a phone is unavailable until explicit New registration from the main surface.

title: Automatic startup
behavior: No application window. Tray only, even when unpaired or startup integration has an error.

title: Copy succeeded
behavior: No success prompt. The clicked SMS popup closes; latest-code shortcut copying remains silent.

title: Pairing completes while hidden
behavior: No forced reopening or toast. Reopen shows the real resulting state.

title: Lock / unlock
behavior: Close SMS windows on lock; no locked-session popups or body retention; no old-message replay on unlock.

title: Suspend / resume
behavior: No activation. Pause retry while suspended; quietly check/reconnect on resume.

title: Arrival receipt / ACK
behavior: No UI. ACK is not successful decryption, popup display or copy.

title: QR scan not observed by Windows
behavior: Keep waiting. Never fabricate a Scanned step from phone-side events unavailable to this client.

title: One Pairing removed
behavior: Remove only its row/popups and applicable latest cache. No Receiver-wide revocation modal.

title: Exit process
behavior: Disconnect; release SMS/OTP memory; keep ordinary settings and Pairing data. No OS clipboard clearing.

title: Install / upgrade / uninstall
behavior: Standard NSIS and OS-owned pages, not Slint replicas. See inventory D01-D10 for every success/failure branch.

title: Windows trust / elevation
behavior: UAC/SmartScreen only if Windows requests it. No app-designed substitute or promise to suppress it.
